findings.claim: The previous CRITICAL is closed only operationally. P/boundary/ was created as an empty untracked directory, and the packet still has no mkdir. Git does not record empty directories, so the precondition is absent in any other checkout, after git clean -fd, or after any tooling that prunes empty directories under .kbd-orchestrator/.

findings.claim: The new index.html guard is correct and harmless, but it can never fire in this packet. static/index.html is tracked at both commits, and vite's emptyOutDir rebuild rewrites it. What actually guarantees a fresh bundle is command order (prepare-bdd before 23-48; build-baseline-frontend before 8), not the guard. If the guard did fire, it would throw at config load, Playwright would exit non-zero, and under the exit-status judging in previous WARNING 5 that reads as FAIL, not the BLOCKED the stopConditions require.
findings.falsePassOrFail: Neither, in this packet. The guard closes previous WARNING 4 for the missing-file case only. It does not detect a stale bundle.
findings.suggestedFix: Optional: also check that an asset hash referenced by index.html exists. When reporting, map a config-load throw to BLOCKED.

findings.claim: Stamping failedAt before route.fulfill closes previous WARNING 3. The late-write filter still uses a strict `write.at > failedAt` with millisecond resolution, so a write whose request event lands in the same millisecond as the stamp is not counted. That is practically unreachable, because the event needs a CDP round trip after fulfill.
findings.suggestedFix: Use `write.at >= failedAt`. The held POST's own request event precedes the stamp, so it is not affected.

changeReview: model-catalog-identity.spec.ts: the error-text assertion matches the product. Trace: the server's /api/live/models/snapshot (src/server/lifecycle_snapshot.rs:165-192) sets string provider_id, model_id and id=provider/model on every record. topics.ts:41 passes projectCatalogModel(record) with no options, so projection.ts:79 has no modelId fallback. projection.ts:81-84 throws `Catalog model record for provider '${providerId}' has no model_id`, where providerId is raw.provider_id unchanged (nonEmptyString does not trim, projection.ts:36-38). uar-sse-adapter.ts:391-397 catches it, then onSnapshotOutcome({ok:false,error}), topics.ts:26-29, domain.ts:58-60, recordLoadFailure, and errorMessage = error.message (domain.ts:44-46). models-ingestion-error.tsx renders 'ERR-MODELS Model catalog update rejected: <message>. Showing the previous catalog.' So toContainText(`'${strippedProviderId}'`) matches the correct build. A build that rejects record 0 for any reason names records[0].provider_id, which the selection loop guarantees differs, so the control now fails that build as intended. The rejection is first-throw-wins in record order, and only the stripped record lacks model_id, so the correct build names the stripped provider. The selection needs at least two providers in the snapshot; the S1 harness configures several, and the custom collision provider is among them.
